name: project-akasha
description: Project Akasha · 虚实共生的二次元实体收藏收纳系统（Cloudflare Serverless）

scripts.dev: npm run build -w web && concurrently -n worker,web -c yellow,cyan "npm:dev -w worker" "npm:dev -w web"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w worker && npm run typecheck -w web
